title: ESM-2-based screening finds yak collagen peptides that inhibit MMP-1
summary: AgeAttnMLP, an ESM-2-based screening model, reached AUC 0.891 under five-fold cross-validation and 0.879 under a cluster-aware grouped evaluation. Screening yak collagen sequences with in silico Alcalase hydrolysis identified TGPPGPSGI, GEPGAPGE and GPSGEPGTA as lead peptides. GEPGAPGE showed the strongest MMP-1 inhibition (IC50 126 ug/mL), and all three peptides extended Caenorhabditis elegans lifespan, most for GPSGEPGTA at 7.5 mg/mL. Potency is modest and in vivo evidence is limited to worms.
ai_technology: ESM-2-based AgeAttnMLP model screening collagen-derived peptide sequences

evidence.tested: MMP-1 inhibition assay and C. elegans lifespan experiments with the three lead peptides.
evidence.unknown: Activity in mammalian systems and in humans; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A protein language-model-based classifier prioritized candidate peptides.
